key_highlights: ASX gains in an $80b US midterms relief rally to finish the week higher despite late-week turbulence.
Department store icon David Jones enters voluntary administration, triggering distress across landlords and suppliers.
National Australia Bank (NAB.AX) dives on margin concerns, diverging sharply from broader market strength.
Qantas (QAN.AX) prepares fare hikes and flight cuts to absorb a $1B fuel cost headwind.
Persistent inflation and RBA 'excess demand' warnings keep monetary policy tight, dampening consumer and housing outlook.

sectors.trend: Severe retail distress underscored by David Jones entering voluntary administration.
sectors.implications: Elevated tenancy vacancy risks for mall REITs (SCG.AX, VCX.AX) and immediate write-down risks for inventory suppliers.

sectors.trend: Outperformance in digital infrastructure countered by workforce rationalisation in private tech.
sectors.implications: NextDC (NXT.AX) surges on cloud/AI data centre demand, while private tech cuts highlight cost discipline.

sectors.trend: Banking margins pressured as RBA maintains restrictive stance amid weakening household balance sheets.
sectors.implications: NAB.AX slump exposes valuation vulnerabilities across major lenders (CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX) as loan growth slows.

sectors.trend: Strong capital raising activity in gold exploration alongside selective battery metals exploration.
sectors.implications: Junior explorers (BPM.AX, CHN.AX, AGC.AX, KNI.AX) and critical minerals plays (CRR.AX) see active speculative turnover.

sectors.trend: Crude oil slump contrasts with elevated jet fuel expenses for transport operators.
sectors.implications: Qantas (QAN.AX) faces margin compression, forcing capacity rationalisation and fare hikes that could test travel demand elasticity.

key_themes: Global midterm relief rally driving ASX rebound (^AXJO) offset by domestic financial and retail drag
RBA hawkishness and persistent inflation squeezing consumer discretionary spending and property valuations
Insolvency in legacy retail cascading into commercial property and wholesale supply chains
Sharp dispersion between outperforming tech/resources and lagging banking heavyweights

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Commercial Real Estate & Retail Tenant Default
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight discretionary retail REITs; reallocate toward industrial and data infrastructure assets.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Prolonged High Interest Rates & Macro Stagnation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hold defensive high-yield cash equivalents, healthcare (CSL.AX), and essential infrastructure.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Major Bank NIM Compression & Credit Deterioration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Trim exposure to Big Four bank equities (NAB.AX, CBA.AX) following earnings divergence.
Avoid unhedged airline equities exposed to high fuel input costs and consumer belt-tightening.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight digital infrastructure and cloud capacity providers.
opportunities.rationale: Structural tailwinds and robust momentum continue to drive outperformance in NextDC.

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to junior gold exploration and capital raising plays.
opportunities.rationale: High broker activity and positive drill results support upside in exploration juniors amid firm precious metal prices.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to discretionary retail landlords and retail-exposed credit.
defensive_moves.rationale: David Jones collapse signals accelerated store closures and downward pressure on mall rental renewals.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge exposure to major Australian banking institutions.
defensive_moves.rationale: NAB's sharp pullback underscores growing earnings headwinds and margin squeeze in retail lending.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 (^AXJO) expected to consolidate around 8,100–8,300 as global risk relief is checked by domestic banking and retail headwinds.
market_outlook.long_term: Subdued medium-term growth capped by household debt strain and housing market vulnerability, partially mitigated by resource resilience.
key_catalysts: RBA monetary policy decisions and commentary on domestic excess demand
Supplier and landlord fallout from the David Jones administration process
Ongoing crude oil and jet fuel volatility affecting corporate transport margins
Global policy direction following the US midterm election outcome
watch_list: Monthly Australian CPI and labour market prints
Retail tenancy vacancy rates and shopping centre foot traffic figures
Bank net interest margins and mortgage stress delinquency indicators
Commodity price trends across gold, lithium, and crude oil
